Bhagyashree was extremely helpful and handled my enquiry very well.

That said, I ran into a frustrating issue with the online chatbot. When I requested to speak to a live agent, the system asked me to select my preferred language, but the text input box disappeared, leaving me unable to respond. I encountered the same problem multiple times. The only way I could proceed was by waiting for an extended period until the agent sent the first message.

This issue is completely separate from Bhagyashree's excellent support, but it appears to be a user interface bug that creates a very poor user experience.

reviews.body: I signed up to Lebara a couple of months ago and my experience has been awful. I signed up using an offer which promised a £15 gift card, which I never received. This happens to other people I know who use Lebara so it is most definitely an issue with their service. Their signal is terrible, I do not ever have data or service. I also had zero data for the first few days that I used them and the staff were so dismissive and unhelpful. I was told to turn my phone off and on… I will be leaving them and urge every one else not to bother with the hassle for the sake of the cheaper service they offer.

reviews.title: Split port finally fixed
reviews.body:
I had a split port (couldn't receive calls or texts) for 5 days...which makes you realise how often you need to be able to receive a verification code for an App.

I requested a new SIM and fitted it when it arrived.

Initially it didn't seem to be working (no signal), so I logged-on to a Lebara web-chat.

Santosh Kamble was friendly and helpful...and more importantly, he fixed the issue.👍

I'd assumed that the SIM would work straight away, but it seems that the SIM ICCID (on the back of the SIM card) needs to be activated after a SIM change.

Anyway, I can now receive calls and texts (as well as make calls and send texts), so that's good news.

Data also works, so the Vodafone to Lebara contract change has been completed.

It took 5 days instead of 1 day, but the far lower Lebara SIM-Only rates justify the (slight) hassle.
